minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  JUNE 9, 2014

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  June 9, 2014
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, June 24, 2014.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Rubincam, Shaffer, Chooljian and Wade
  Members absent: Peterson

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

None

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-381-14: Application to top 3 Casurina trees located in the parkway adjacent to
  1012 Palos Verdes Drive West

  Applicant:  Mike Ho
  1012 Palos Verdes Drive West
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee Member Shaffer moved and Committee Member Chooljian
seconded to approve the topping of 3 Casurina trees located in the parkway
adjacent to 1012 Palos Verdes Drive West by 2 feet. The vote was (3-1, Wade
dissenting, Peterson absent).

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, June 24, 2014.
  Directors approval  SR
 2.  PC-382-14; Application to remove 1 Eucalyptus located in the parkway
  adjacent to 1309 Via Margarita

  Applicant:  Grace Jung
  1309 Via Margarita
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee Member Wade moved and Committee Member Chooljian
seconded to approve the removal of 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the parkway
adjacent to 1309 Via Margarita. The vote was (3-1, Shaffer dissenting, Peterson
absent).

3.  PC-379-14; Application to remove 4 Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway and
  center median adjacent to 1516 Paseo La Cresta

  Applicant:  Robert Vasey
  1421 Via Arco
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee Member Wade moved and Committee Member Chooljian
seconded to approve with modification. Eucalyptus tree #4 is approved to be
removed according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. The
applicant is required to pay $500 to the ‘Tree Bank’. Eucalyptus tree #1, 2 & 3 are
not approved for removal. The vote was (4-0, Peterson absent).

OLD BUSINESS - None

NEW BUSINESS - None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

4.  Civic Center Park tree removals and replacement

Staff is directed to replant trees, colorful shrubs and succulents in Civic Center
Park.

5.  Update on 2014 applications - Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT

Adjourned to July 14, 2014

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, June 24, 2014.
  Directors approval  SR
